'''Brandelwyn "Bran" al'Vere''', is the Mayor of [[Emond's Field]], in the [[Two Rivers]]. [[Egwene al'Vere]] is one of Bran and Marin's children.

== Appearance ==
With sparse gray hair and a round face, he has the look of many innkeepers: wearing an apron that strains over his wide girth. Surprisingly, he walks lightly for a man of his size. On special occasions, he wears a silver medallion of scales, the symbol of the office of Mayor.

== History ==
Bran was born in {{ne|937}}, married his wife Marin in {{ne|964}}, and was elected Mayor of Emond's Field in {{ne|978}}.

As the village Mayor and the head of the [[Village Council]], people are always taking their problems to Bran for solving. He is also the owner of the [[Winespring Inn]], which he runs with the help of his wife, [[Marin al'Vere|Marin]]. The cellar of the inn contains many barrels of brandy and ale made by Bran, and sometimes apple cider or apple brandy made by [[Tam al'Thor]], and delivered every year about Bel Tine. 

== Activities ==
He is part of the Village council, which is in session when [[Padan Fain]] arrives.

Bran tells Perrin of the death of his entire family when he arrives at the Winespring Inn with [[Faile]].{{ref/book|4|29}}

Bran tells [[Dain Bornhald]] that there will be no arrests, no intimidation or other trouble from the Whitecloaks while they are in the village defending against the [[Trollocs]].{{ref/book|4|45}}

He helps defend Emond's Field against the invading Trollocs.{{ref/book|4|56}}

== Etymology ==
His name is an allusion to the Baranduin River (more commonly called the Brandywine River) of ''Lord of the Rings'' by J.R.R. Tolkien''.''

== In the television series ==
* In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|television series]], {{TVlink|Bran al'Vere}} is portrayed by actor {{TVlink|Michael Tuahine}}
